story.title: Villa confirm club-record Jackson signing as deal agreed for Mbaye
story.summary: Aston Villa have confirmed the club-record signing of Nicolas Jackson from Chelsea while also reaching a verbal agreement to sign Paris Saint-Germain winger Ibrahim Mbaye.
